tools.name: get_plan

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "about_umbhost" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_plans, read_page, list_pages · Private data: about_umbhost · Public sink: list_plans.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_plans, read_page, list_pages · Private data: about_umbhost · Public sink: list_plans

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_plan" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get one UmbHost hosting plan by its key, with its full per-cycle prices, config options, and add-ons. Returns null if the key is unknown." → after: "Get one UmbHost hosting or licence plan by its key, with its full per-cycle prices, config options, and add-ons. The key is the plan's GUID 'key' from list_plans, not its name. Optional ISO currency (GBP, EUR, USD, AUD); defaults to GBP. An unknown key returns an error."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
